title: HB820 (2026 Regular): Handgun Permits - Special Endorsement for Security Clearance Holders

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Maryland text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2026RS/bills/hb/hb0820f.pdf)
provenance.note: first reader: bill as filed; no enrolled text read; no passage vote recorded.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-315): (B) A PERMIT ISSUED UNDER THIS SUBTITLE SHALL BEAR A SPECIAL ENDORSEMENT THAT SHOWS THAT THE PERMIT HOLDER HAS ENHANCED PRIVILEGES TO WEAR, CARRY, OR TRANSPORT A HANDGUN IF, BASED ON A BACKGROUND INVESTIGATION, THE SECRETARY DETERMINES THAT THE PERMIT HOLDER IS: (1) A CURRENT EMPLOYEE OF THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT WHO CURRENTLY HOLDS TOP SECRET/SENSITIVE COMPARTMENTED INFORMATION SECURITY CLEARANCE; OR (2) A RETIRED EMPLOYEE OF THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT WHO HELD A TOP SECRET/SENSITIVE COMPARTMENTED INFORMATION SECURITY CLEARANCE FOR AT LEAST 10 CONSECUTIVE YEARS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING RETIREMENT FROM FEDERAL EMPLOYMENT.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-315): (C) NOTWITHSTANDING ANY LAW OR ORDINANCE THAT PROHIBITS THE WEARING, CARRYING, OR TRANSPORTING OF A HANDGUN AT A PLACE, A PERSON WHO HAS A PERMIT BEARING AN ENDORSEMENT UNDER THIS SECTION MAY WEAR, CARRY, OR TRANSPORT A HANDGUN AT ANY PLACE WHERE A LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICIAL IS AUTHORIZED TO WEAR, CARRY, OR TRANSPORT A HANDGUN IN THE PERFORMANCE OF THE OFFICIAL’S DUTIES.
